verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming tool. The evidence says it has no account or server, but it documents no feature for exporting user data such as settings or pairings in open formats. Log files sitting in a Library folder and the ability to remove paired devices are adjacent behaviors, not a data-export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
